info.title: Mercenta API — Mainnet release contract
info.description: Mainnet domain has read-only commerce metadata and a nonfinancial manual support submission endpoint on Arc chain 5042. Real purchases, deposits, agent execution and wallet sessions are CLOSED. Requests are never forwarded to the testnet account backend. The inherited paths describe the intended surface, not enabled real buying. A production checkout contract must be finalized before activation.

get.description: Read-only preparation snapshot, not launch approval or live runtime health. Payments and signing remain closed.

gates.detailEn: Two RPCs returned chain ID 5042. Official token and Gateway addresses are pinned. This is recorded evidence, not live uptime.
gates.detailRu: Два RPC подтвердили chain ID 5042. Адреса USDC и Gateway закреплены по документации. Это снимок проверки, не live-доступность.

gates.detailEn: Separate Mainnet receipt and launch-policy modules are prepared. Three confirmations, exact USDC precision and the $10 procurement reserve must be validated in deployment.
gates.detailRu: Подготовлены отдельные Mainnet receipt и launch-policy модули. В production нужны три подтверждения, точная сумма USDC и резерв закупки $10.

gates.detailEn: The current operational backend remains Testnet-only. A separate database, secrets, owner session and production order lifecycle must be integrated before release.
gates.detailRu: Действующий backend остаётся Testnet-only. До запуска нужны отдельная база, ключи, сессия владельца и интеграция production-заказов.

gates.detailEn: Requires fresh owner approval, a verified provider-side spend cap and one exact payment, delivered item and refund check. No Mainnet payment has been executed.
gates.detailRu: Нужны свежее разрешение владельца, проверенный лимит на стороне поставщика, одна точная оплата, выдача товара и проверка возврата. Mainnet-оплата не выполнялась.

gates.detailEn: Production restore drills, monitoring alerts, pause/reconcile handling and customer refund obligations must be confirmed. A green build is not these proofs.
gates.detailRu: Нужны production-проверки восстановления, алертов, паузы и сверки заказов, а также процедуры возврата. Успешная сборка их не заменяет.

get.summary: Read-only external Ethereum USDC supply market
get.description: Real Ethereum chain 1 observations, including on Testnet hosts. Metadata only: no Mercenta custody, signing, deposits, bridging or guaranteed returns. Unavailable/stale verification does not substitute a rate. No query parameters accepted.

200.description: Verified or unavailable market snapshot; never authority to invest.

walletSession.name: mercenta_session
walletSession.description: HttpOnly, host-only verified wallet session. Obtain through wallet challenge in the app. No session carry across networks.

bearerAuth.description: Mercenta integration key generated in Account. /api/v1 supports account, dashboard and orders with key scopes; testnet only.

x-schema-notes: Input constraints are generated from Zod definitions. Runtime business rules (budget sums, reserves, stock, idempotency and ownership) are enforced by the server. Generic response schemas are not a typed SDK guarantee.
